caption: The drawing features a stylized eagle with outstretched wings depicted in a muted green color, with darker and lighter shades adding texture to the feathers. The eagle's head is turned to its right, and it grasps a flowing banner or ribbon in its beak. Across its chest, the eagle bears a shield that has a design of horizontal stripes in the lower half and stars in the upper half, rendered in the same green tones as the rest of the eagle. The eagle's left talon clutches a bundle of arrows, while its right talon holds a cluster of leaves, likely olive branches. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a small inscription at the lower right corner that reads “Molly H. Badenhausen, WPA Federal Art Project, Virginia.”
title: Wall Ornament
